Distillate fuel oil: > 15 ppm to 500 ppm sulfur

limitations: Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration, Weekly Petroleum Status Report, October 15, 2026, table 4. Necessary numerical excerpt, reshaped by Decision OS; no EIA endorsement.

UNITS_VERIFIED_FROM=https://www.eia.gov/petroleum/supply/weekly/pdf/table4.pdf; values are million barrels. Related DNAV HTML uses thousand barrels and must not be substituted without explicit conversion.

RIGHTS=https://www.eia.gov/about/copyrights_reuse.php; EIA-authored U.S. government statistical products may be used and distributed with source/date acknowledgement. EIA-hosted protected third-party spot-price tables are outside this excerpt.
All stock levels are at the end of the period. Values are million barrels in table4 CSV/PDF; related dnav table uses thousand barrels.
CSV retains three decimal places; PDF displays one decimal place.
Domestic and Customs-cleared foreign stocks at/in transit to refineries, ethanol plants, bulk terminals, pipelines; some stocks estimated.
Crude Oil includes SPR; Commercial excludes SPR. PADD and Cushing/Alaska rows overlap totals and are not independent quantities to sum.
Propane/propylene excludes terminal propylene after the documented revision.
Other Oils includes specified products and estimated minor stocks; Unfinished Oils is a separate included component.
Publisher differences/percent changes may be based on unrounded values; preserve reported values separately from recalculation.
10/21 announced WPSR format change affects price tables11/12/14 and appendices; no observed discontinuation of stocks data.

Original table includes overlapping products and regions, so 26 rows are series rather than 26 independent commodity types. Cushing and Alaska-in-transit overlap larger geographic/total stocks. No issuer exposure or additive basket is inferred.

Two absolute stock dates are independently present in the same acquired release. Original publisher previous-year values and changes are supplemental fields and are not additional reader observations or historical vintage certification.

Changes on displayed CSV values and publisher difference fields are retained separately. Several rows differ by 0.001 million barrels; this is not silently repaired and does not by itself establish publisher error.
